The paper unfolded with a dry rustle, bearing faded indigo ink that whispered of a ship long forgotten by living memory.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市沉浸在一片幽蓝的寂静中。喧嚣退去，白日里拥挤的街道此刻空旷而深邃，唯有昏黄的路灯将斑驳树影拉得狭长。雾气在楼宇缝隙间轻柔流淌，偶尔驶过一辆亮着微光的洒水车，在湿润的路面上留下一道蜿蜒的水痕。街角的便利店静静亮着暖白的光芒，早班的环卫工人已在夜色中挥动扫帚，清脆的沙沙声唤醒了这片沉睡的钢筋丛林。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a task solves a big problem by repeating the exact same smaller task on smaller pieces.\n• Imagine opening a set of Russian nesting dolls, where each doll holds a tinier twin until you reach the very smallest one.\n• You must always have a stopping rule—like reaching that tiniest doll—so the repetition does not keep going forever."}
